department: Doctoral School Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences (ED STEP)

deadline.value: The CD3 calendar for 2026-2027 is a linked document that is not in the page text, so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the STEP pages.

supervisor.value: You must have a thesis supervisor from a school-attached lab who commits to supervising you before admission.
supervisor.quote: l'engagement d'un directeur ou d'une directrice de thèse à vous encadrer tout au long de votre cursus

funding.value: Candidates either win the school's doctoral-contract competition or show three years of funding.
funding.quote: être Lauréat du concours d’attribution des contrats Doctoraux de l’ED

entry_route.value: You need a master's or engineering diploma; foreign diplomas need equivalence from the CD3 commission.
entry_route.quote: Être titulaire d’un diplôme de Master ou d’Ingénieur

notes: Admission requires at least the French minimum wage for a single person as monthly funding. The CD3 calendar for 2026-2027 is a linked file.
